definitions.explanation: A pair of people who work together as a team, especially a comedy duo or any well-matched partnership. Short for English "combination."

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧コンビだ。
examples.english: The two of them make a good pair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{お笑|わら}いコンビ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A popular comedy duo is on TV.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧コンビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧きた⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: The two, who have teamed up for many years, are perfectly in sync.

notes:
Clipped from English "combination." Usually refers to a team of exactly two; for larger groups use トリオ (three) or ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧コンビ: a good pairing
- コンビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to team up; to form a duo
- ⟦お{笑|わら}い→お笑い：10298_owarai⟧コンビ: a comedy duo

NOTE: コンビ on its own usually means a duo; コンビニ (convenience store) is an unrelated abbreviation.
